column2: A student tried to interject during the lecture to ask whether the formula also applied to liquids.
column3: 一名學生在講課中途想插話，問這個公式是否也適用於液體。
column5: inter 之間 + ject 丟：把話丟進別人談話中間

column2: The speaker began with solar power but digressed into a long story about her grandfather's farm.
column3: 講者從太陽能開始談起，卻離題講了很長一段關於祖父農場的故事。
column5: di 離開 + gress 走：走離了原本的路

column2: When a student asked about ancient music, the lecture went off on a tangent about musical instruments.
column3: 有學生問起古代音樂，課程便岔到樂器的話題上。
column4: go off on a tangent (離題發揮)
column5: tangent 像「談讚」：越談越讚，卻離題了

column2: Before the quiz, the teacher recapitulated the three main causes of the war in two minutes.
column3: 小考前，老師用兩分鐘扼要重述了戰爭的三個主要原因。
column4: recapitulate the main points (重述要點)
column5: re 再 + capit 頭（capital）：再回到頭部重點說一次

column2: The first lecture gave an overview of the course, covering topics from ancient trade to modern markets.
column3: 第一堂課概述整門課程，涵蓋從古代貿易到現代市場的主題。
column5: over 在上方 + view 看：從高處俯瞰全貌

column2: The professor gave us a breakdown of the final grade: forty percent exams, thirty percent essays.
column3: 教授向我們分項說明期末成績：考試占百分之四十，論文占百分之三十。
column4: breakdown of costs (成本分項明細)
column5: break 打破 + down 下來：把整體拆成小項目

column2: Our biology assignment is to observe a pond for a week and record every animal we see.
column3: 我們的生物作業是觀察池塘一週，並記錄看到的每種動物。
column5: as 朝向 + sign 簽名：被簽發給你的任務

column2: The deadline for submitting the research proposal is midnight on Friday; late papers will lose points.
column3: 研究計畫書的繳交期限是週五午夜，遲交會被扣分。
column5: dead 死 + line 線：過了這條線就「死」了

column2: Because she was sick for a week, Mia asked the instructor for an extension on her essay.
column3: 因為生病一個星期，米亞向講師申請延長論文繳交期限。
column5: extend 延伸 → extension 就是延長出來的時間

column2: The rubric explains exactly how many points each part of the presentation is worth.
column3: 評分標準表清楚說明簡報的每個部分各占多少分。
column5: rubric 像「入布里克」：入榜前先看的分數表

column2: Her teacher's feedback on the draft pointed out unclear sentences and suggested better examples.
column3: 老師對初稿的回饋指出了不清楚的句子，並建議更好的例子。
column5: feed 餵 + back 回來：把意見餵回給作者

column2: One key criterion for the scholarship is a student's financial need rather than test scores alone.
column3: 這項獎學金的一個關鍵準則，是學生的經濟需求，而不只看考試分數。
column5: criterion 像「快來錯里安」：評判對錯的標尺，複數是 criteria

column2: At the end of the term, students fill out an evaluation of the course and the instructor.
column3: 學期末，學生會填寫對課程和講師的評鑑表。
column5: e 出 + value 價值：把價值評估出來

column2: The final assessment includes a written test, a group project, and an oral presentation.
column3: 期末評量包括一份筆試、一項小組專題和一場口頭報告。
column5: as 旁邊 + sess 坐：坐在旁邊打分數的人

column2: Weekly quizzes serve as formative assessment, helping teachers see which topics students still find confusing.
column3: 每週小考屬於形成性評量，幫助老師了解學生仍覺得困惑的主題。
column5: form 形成：學習還在成形中，邊學邊檢查

column2: The final exam is a summative test that measures what students have learned during the whole semester.
column3: 期末考是總結性測驗，衡量學生整個學期學到了什麼。
column5: sum 總和：學完之後加總成績

column2: Studying a little every day produces cumulative progress, so small efforts eventually add up to major gains.
column3: 每天讀一點會帶來累積的進步，所以小小的努力終究會匯聚成大成果。
column5: cumulus 積雲：一朵朵堆起來，越堆越高

column2: The comprehensive exam covers everything taught in the program, from basic theory to advanced methods.
column3: 這場綜合考試涵蓋課程裡教過的一切，從基礎理論到進階方法。
column5: com 全部 + prehend 抓住：把全部都抓住

column2: Admission to the medical program is rigorous, requiring top grades, long interviews, and years of volunteer work.
column3: 醫學學程的入學標準嚴格，需要頂尖成績、冗長面試和多年的志工服務。
column5: rigid 僵硬：標準硬邦邦，毫不放水

column2: The historian was meticulous, checking every date and footnote twice before sending the book to the printer.
column3: 這位歷史學家一絲不苟，把書送印前每個日期和註腳都檢查了兩遍。
column4: meticulous attention to detail (對細節一絲不苟)
column5: meticulous 像「美的可愛死」：細心的人把細節做到美

column2: Running late, he gave the report only a cursory glance and missed the mistake in the table.
column3: 他趕時間，只匆匆瞥了報告一眼，沒發現表格裡的錯誤。
column5: cur 跑（current 水流）：一路跑過去，看得很快

column2: Her lecture offered a profound insight into how language shapes the way people think.
column3: 她的演講對語言如何塑造人們的思考方式提出了深刻的見解。
column5: pro 向前 + found 底：往底部深處挖

column2: The essay was shallow, repeating well-known facts without exploring why they matter.
column3: 這篇文章很膚淺，只重複眾所周知的事實，卻沒探討它們為何重要。
column5: shallow 像「蝦漏」：蝦子只在淺水裡漏出來，不夠深

column2: The lawyer gave such a persuasive speech that most of the jury changed their minds.
column3: 律師的演說非常有說服力，大部分陪審員都改變了想法。
column5: per 徹底 + suade 勸：徹底勸動別人

column2: The documentary presents compelling evidence that the river's pollution came from a nearby factory.
column3: 這部紀錄片提出令人信服的證據，顯示河川汙染來自附近的工廠。
column5: compel 強迫：逼你不得不相信

column2: Her cogent argument for building a new bridge convinced even the most skeptical council members.
column3: 她主張興建新橋的論證嚴密有力，連最懷疑的議員都被說服了。
column4: a cogent argument (嚴密有力的論證)
column5: cogent 像「夠江特」：夠硬的論證，讓人無從反駁

column2: The experiment was flawed because the sample was too small to give reliable results.
column3: 這項實驗有缺陷，因為樣本太小，無法得到可靠的結果。
column4: a flawed design (有缺陷的設計)
column5: flaw 裂縫 + ed：杯子有裂縫，就是有缺陷

column2: The argument is fallacious, since it assumes that because two events happened together, one must have caused the other.
column3: 這個論證是謬誤的，因為它假定兩件事同時發生，就必定一個造成另一個。
column5: fall 跌倒：邏輯一腳踩空，跌倒出錯

column2: His answer was so incoherent that the committee could not tell what he was trying to argue.
column3: 他的回答語無倫次，委員會聽不出他想主張什麼。
column5: in 不 + cohere 黏合：話黏不起來，一團亂

column2: The textbook gives a lucid explanation of how vaccines teach the body to fight disease.
column3: 這本教科書清楚說明疫苗如何教導身體對抗疾病。
column5: lucid 與 lux 光有關：像打開燈，一切看得清楚

column2: An articulate speaker, Jenna explained the complex theory so clearly that everyone understood, and she could articulate each step.
column3: 珍娜口才清晰，把複雜的理論講得讓大家都聽懂，也能清楚說出每個步驟。
column5: art 藝術 + i + culate：像藝術品一樣把話一節節說清楚

column2: The senator gave an eloquent speech about education that brought many listeners to tears.
column3: 參議員發表了一場關於教育的雄辯演說，讓許多聽眾落淚。
column5: e 出 + loqu 說話：話語自然流瀉而出

column2: Nervous and inarticulate, the young scientist struggled to explain his own results to the audience.
column3: 這位年輕科學家緊張又表達不清，努力想向聽眾解釋自己的結果。
column5: in 不 + articulate 表達清楚：反過來，說不清楚

column2: In legal parlance, a minor is anyone under the age of eighteen.
column3: 用法律術語來說，未成年人指的是任何未滿十八歲的人。
column4: in medical parlance (用醫學上的說法)
column5: parlance 與 parlor 客廳：聊天時用的特定說法

column2: The article was so full of technical jargon that ordinary readers could hardly follow it.
column3: 這篇文章充滿專業術語，一般讀者幾乎看不懂。
column5: jargon 像「雜根」：一堆雜亂的行話像草根亂長

column2: Biologists use precise terminology to name each species so that scientists everywhere understand each other.
column3: 生物學家用精確的術語為每個物種命名，讓各地科學家能彼此理解。
column5: term 術語 + inology：一整套術語的體系

column2: Plate tectonics, the study of Earth's moving crust, helps geologists explain why earthquakes strike certain regions.
column3: 板塊構造學研究會移動的地殼，幫助地質學家解釋為什麼某些地區容易發生地震。
column4: study of tectonics (構造地質學研究)
column5: tecton 建造：研究地殼如何被建造與移動

column2: Over millions of years, layers of sediment settled at the bottom of the lake and hardened into rock.
column3: 數百萬年來，一層層沉積物沉到湖底，逐漸硬化成岩石。
column5: sediment 像「沙地門」：沙一點點沉下來，就是沉積物

column2: Airplanes often cruise in the stratosphere, where the air is thin and storms are rare.
column3: 飛機常在平流層巡航，那裡空氣稀薄，也很少有風暴。
column4: ozone in the stratosphere (平流層的臭氧)
column5: strat 層：一層一層穩定分開的大氣層

column2: Clouds, rain, and wind all occur in the troposphere, the lowest layer of Earth's atmosphere.
column3: 雲、雨和風都發生在對流層，也就是地球大氣最底層。
column4: weather in the troposphere (對流層的天氣)
column5: trop 翻轉：空氣上下翻轉對流，天氣在這一層
